summary.bn: এক তারে (1-Wire) তাপমাত্রা পাঠায়; একই তারে অনেকগুলো বসানো যায়। DQ থেকে VDD-তে ৪.৭ kΩ পুল-আপ লাগে।
summary.en: Sends temperature over one wire (1-Wire); many can share the same wire. Needs a 4.7 kΩ pull-up from DQ to VDD.

simplified: The chip answers command by command as Maxim's datasheet gives them: Search, Read, Match and Skip ROM, Alarm Search, Convert T, Read and Write Scratchpad, Copy, Recall and Read Power Supply. Each reset and each bit is one exchange; the timing of the pulses on the wire is not modelled, only the time each step takes.

It reads +85 °C until its first conversion, and a conversion takes the datasheet's longest time for its resolution (750 ms at 12 bits). Its reading is the slider's value rounded to its resolution, with no error or self-heating.
It needs its pull-up resistor: without one on the DQ line the lab finds no device and warns. Parasite power (VDD to ground) is not modelled: it needs 3.0 V to 5.5 V on VDD.
Its alarm limits start at 75 °C and 70 °C, the values users commonly read from new sensors; the datasheet leaves them to the factory.
Each probe in the lab gets its own ROM code, made from its name; the family code is 28h as on the real chip.
